title: Room Full of Blues, Sandy's Place and Blues Alley
summary: At Sandy's she first met the young band Room Full of Blues and told them to learn to read music; she heard them again at the Bottom Line. Sandy wants her back but she is sick, and she also plays Blues Alley in Washington.
